name: SCOUT Flood Depth 2020-2040 without NbS
description: Projected flood depth in metres for 2020 to 2040 without nature-based solutions (NbS), from SCOUT's Quad Cities flood projections. A cell with no depth holds no value. SCOUT's 2020_2040_noNbS_4326_cropped.tif whole: 2592 by 2064 cells on its grid (EPSG:4326, cells of 0.000101 degrees), longitude -90.6879 to -90.4253 and latitude 41.4150 to 41.6242, every cell as SCOUT ships it, compressed losslessly. The FloodScenarios test dataflow reads it. From SCOUT, https://github.com/urban-toolkit/scout, backend/compute/quad_city_flooding_simulation/data_substitutes, used with the permission of SCOUT's authors.
